list.name: device
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT device FROM usage_event ORDER BY 1

list.name: harness
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT harness FROM usage_event ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd), 0) AS "MTD spend" FROM usage_event WHERE ts >= date_trunc('month', now()) AND device IN ($device) AND harness IN ($harness)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd), 0) AS "spend" FROM usage_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND device IN ($device) AND harness IN ($harness)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens + reasoning_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_5m_tokens + cache_write_1h_tokens), 0) AS "tokens" FROM usage_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND device IN ($device) AND harness IN ($harness)

SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(input_tokens + cache_read_tokens) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(cache_read_tokens)::float / SUM(input_tokens + cache_read_tokens) END AS "cache-read ratio" FROM usage_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND device IN ($device) AND harness IN ($harness)

SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, '1d') AS time, COALESCE(model, '(unpriced)') AS metric, SUM(cost_usd) AS value FROM usage_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND device IN ($device) AND harness IN ($harness) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, '1d') AS time,
  SUM(input_tokens) AS "input",
  SUM(output_tokens) AS "output",
  SUM(reasoning_tokens) AS "reasoning",
  SUM(cache_read_tokens) AS "cache read",
  SUM(cache_write_5m_tokens + cache_write_1h_tokens) AS "cache write"
FROM usage_event
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND device IN ($device) AND harness IN ($harness)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT regexp_replace(COALESCE(project, '(unknown)'), '^.*/', '') AS project, SUM(cost_usd) AS cost FROM usage_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND device IN ($device) AND harness IN ($harness) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cost DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT device, SUM(cost_usd) AS cost FROM usage_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND device IN ($device) AND harness IN ($harness) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cost DESC

SELECT billing, SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens + reasoning_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_5m_tokens + cache_write_1h_tokens) AS tokens FROM usage_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND device IN ($device) AND harness IN ($harness) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY tokens DESC

SELECT
  s.started_at,
  s.harness,
  s.device,
  regexp_replace(COALESCE(s.project, '(unknown)'), '^.*/', '') AS project,
  s.model,
  s.duration,
  s.responses,
  s.total_tokens,
  s.cost_usd
FROM usage_session s
WHERE s.last_event_at >= $__timeFrom() AND s.started_at <= $__timeTo()
  AND s.device IN ($device) AND s.harness IN ($harness)
ORDER BY s.cost_usd DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Counterfactual cost over time — actual vs alternatives
panels.description: What the same token stream would have cost at other models' rates. Estimates: token counts are not portable across tokenizers.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, '1d') AS time, 'actual (as billed/notional)' AS metric, SUM(cost_usd) AS value FROM usage_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND device IN ($device) AND harness IN ($harness) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroup(day, '1d') AS time, scenario || ' [' || cache_model || ']' AS metric, SUM(scenario_cost_usd) AS value FROM usage_scenario_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(day) AND device IN ($device) AND harness IN ($harness) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: What the local model is saving
panels.description: Ollama-billed tokens repriced onto hosted models. Local inference has no prompt caching, so context is re-sent as fresh input every turn — which is why the input count is large.

targets.rawSql: SELECT scenario, cache_model, device, responses, tokens, would_have_cost_usd FROM usage_local_savings WHERE device IN ($device) ORDER BY would_have_cost_usd ASC

panels.title: Cheapest alternative per project
panels.description: The decision aid. Check cache_model before acting: a target with 'none' has no prompt caching and bills cache reads at full input rate.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (project)
  regexp_replace(project, '^.*/', '') AS project,
  scenario,
  cache_model,
  actual_cost_usd,
  scenario_cost_usd,
  delta_usd
FROM usage_scenario_project
WHERE harness IN ($harness)
ORDER BY project, scenario_cost_usd ASC

panels.title: Effective rates applied, by model
panels.description: The per-million-token rates actually used to compute cost. A step here is a models.json price change, not a change in your behaviour — which is precisely what storing the rates makes visible.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, '1d') AS time, model || ' · output' AS metric, avg(rate_output) AS value FROM usage_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND rate_output IS NOT NULL AND device IN ($device) AND harness IN ($harness) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, '1d') AS time, model || ' · input' AS metric, avg(rate_input) AS value FROM usage_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND rate_input IS NOT NULL AND device IN ($device) AND harness IN ($harness) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
